pr_title: Support runtime fields in synthetic source
pr_body:
This is needed to use runtime fields in TSDS that use synthetic source by default.

Fixes #98287
pr_comments: Hi @kkrik-es, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

> One more nit, but LGTM otherwise assuming CI is happy. Thanks for your patience with my nit-picking!

Thanks so much for taking the time to provide fruitful feedback. This is my first time looking at synthetic source, I think I learned a lot through this PR.
Fwiw I also updated documentation, removed listed restrictions around using `params._source` in scripts.

issue_context.title: Allow access to _source In scripts when synthetic source is enabled.
